propositions: 108 store tickets carry Success Criteria as plain bullets instead of Acceptance Criteria checkboxes, making them invisible to the P1 blocking floor and uncountable by _count_ac_items
A migration script must convert Success Criteria bullets to Acceptance Criteria checkbox items via rebar.edit_ticket, preserving auditability and requiring explicit flag to touch non-closed tickets
The rewrite must handle all block shapes: SC-only, both headings, mixed bullet/checkbox items, SC as last section, and tickets with no SC block
Migration invalidates plan-review attestations as stale-material due to changed material fingerprint, but no in-flight claims are disrupted when run on closed tickets first
Post-migration verification must confirm no Success Criteria headings remain, all 106 migrated tickets meet the AC floor (_count_ac_items >= 1), and the process is idempotent
